manski_bounds_on_median_over_evaluable.note: Assumption-free: every censored query placed at the observed minimum (lower) or maximum (upper). Wide by construction; reported to show what the data alone can identify.

per_draw.note: The real-JOB run aggregated three sampling draws per query (--lower-seeds 1 2 3); the certificate's cost is linear in the draws, so these are the as-run figures divided by the draw count, the quantity comparable to the one-draw STATS-CEB run.

one_draw_measured.note: One-draw certificate re-timed on the same templates (verify_draw_cost); the censored count is the as-run one, since the re-timing covered exactly the templates that finished.

size_association.interpretation: A positive rho means the certificate gets relatively more expensive on larger joins, so the censored (larger) queries would sit above the observed ones and the reported median understates the full-benchmark value.
